title: Axiom of foundation
summary: Every nonempty set has a member disjoint from it, blocking ordinary descending membership loops.

context.note: This node belongs to one explicit foundational presentation; alternate foundations may encode it differently.

assumptions.text: The declared first-order set theory context is fixed.

content.plain: Every nonempty set has a member disjoint from it, blocking ordinary descending membership loops.
content.example: The axiom rules out x∈x in ordinary ZF set theory.
content.caveat: Non-well-founded set theories deliberately replace this axiom; foundation is a branch choice, not logic alone.
